rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice after a clause, often following 完 or 咗, as in V 完 之後，B.

example.english: After we finish eating, we'll go watch a movie.
example.traditional: 食完飯之後，我哋去睇戲。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening later in time; it does not specifically mean following someone.

example.english: We'll go see a movie after eating.
example.traditional: 食完飯之後，我哋去睇戲。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this when the following action happens next or when someone or something follows another.

example.english: We went in after lining up.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 paai4 deoi6 gan1 zyu6 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically for being or moving behind someone or something in space.

example.english: You walk in front, and I'll follow after you from behind.
example.traditional: 你行前面，我喺後面跟住你。
example.jyutping: nei5 haang4 cin4 min6 ngo5 hai2 hau6 min6 gan1 zyu6 nei5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something happening later than another event.

example.english: We went to see a movie after dinner.
example.jyutping: sik6 faan6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this for actively chasing or pursuing a person or thing, especially in speech.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 zeoi1 zyu6 go3 caak6

rows.note: Use this when someone or something is physically behind A or leaves a trail behind A.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 nei5 hau6 min6 paai4 gan2 deoi6

rows.meaning: named after; in the style of
rows.note: Use this formal construction when something is named after A or modeled on A.

example.english: This bridge was named after Sun Yat-sen.
example.traditional: 呢座橋係以孫中山命名嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 zo6 kiu4 hai6 ji5 syun1 zung1 saan1 ming6 ming4 ge3
